pages.text: 02:02 Dispatched to reported vehicle stop, eastbound arterial. Unit 1421 acknowledged.
02:10 Vehicle stopped. White sedan, two occupants. Plate recorded in CAD.
02:14 Driver produced licence. Identification recorded. Passenger remained seated.
02:18 Roadside screening device serial TPS-409 retrieved from cruiser locker. Pre-shift test log consulted.
02:25 Screening demand read from card. Sample provided at 02:27.
02:31 Radioed dispatch for secondary unit. Rear cargo area observed from exterior.
02:40 Transport commenced to 52 Division. Odometer recorded.
03:10 Arrival at booking counter. Property inventory commenced with booking officer.
03:22 Rights to counsel read a second time at booking. Response recorded.
03:40 Breath technician attended. Instrument identified by serial number.
04:05 Samples completed. Certificate printed and attached to file.
04:30 Subject released on undertaking. Copy of documents provided.
